headline: Binance says outflows are stabilising after its record hack, while the hacker moved about $293M of stolen XRP early Monday and the market waits for Tuesday's midterms.

market.asOf: Live price feeds could not be read this run; snapshot from a CoinDesk report published 04:42 UTC Mon 2 Nov (11:42 Bangkok). Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37, up from 34 yesterday, on the Crypto Fear & Greed Index, per CoinGabbar

stories.title: Binance says outflows are stabilising; 95% of the stolen funds replaced, full reserves proof due Tuesday
stories.summary: Binance reopened withdrawals in stages on Sunday after the roughly $6.3B hack. It says outflows are now stabilising and that it has replaced 95% of the stolen funds with its own money. Its full proof of reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is promised by Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC).
points: In the first 9.5 hours after reopening, $4.65B was withdrawn and $1.01B deposited: about $3.64B net, or 2.1% of $171B in assets, per Binance via The Block.
Outside data disagrees: DefiLlama showed a $4.05B net outflow over 24 hours (The Block), while Reuters cites DefiLlama at $5.81B, a figure Binance called inaccurate.
Binance has covered 95% of the stolen funds, up from 80% Friday and 90% Saturday; the last 5% is less-liquid tokens it is still buying, per Brad Feld and Reuters.
The theft size also differs by source: about $6.3B per Binance, $6.43B per Elliptic.
The full proof takes 40 to 50 hours of computing, so Binance moved it from Monday to Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC), per Brad Feld.

sources.label: Reuters via Lufkin Daily News: outflows stabilising

stories.title: Hacker moves about $293M of stolen XRP as North Korea's laundering continues
stories.summary: About 233.46M stolen XRP moved to six new wallets early Monday, after sitting still for about 80 hours. The FBI has named North Korea's TraderTraitor group. Investigators are tracking laundering through Tron and cross-chain swap services.
points: The XRP (about $293M) moved in large transfers between 03:52 and 04:00 UTC on 2 Nov; none had moved onward as of 04:37 UTC, per Bitcoin.com.
On Tron, Tether froze 378.7M USDT, but about $242M moved in two days, mostly out through Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis, per The Block.
The attacker began converting 970,522 SOL (about $96M) into BTC on Sunday; 18,270 stolen BTC have not moved since Thursday, per CoinDesk.
Binance says about $3B has been frozen; Elliptic counts $2.85B verified frozen or seized, about 44% of the theft.

sources.label: CoinDesk: SOL to BTC, unmoved BTC

stories.title: Bitcoin steadies before Tuesday's midterms after a $643M ETF outflow
stories.summary: Bitcoin was near $78,600 early Monday, its third straight daily gain, per CoinDesk. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643.3M on Friday, the most since June. Traders now face Tuesday's US midterm elections.
points: Friday's ETF outflow erased about 63.6% of 2026's roughly $1B net inflow; IBIT lost $233.7M and FBTC $201.4M, per CoinDesk using SoSoValue data.
Binance order-book depth fell 25-30% after the hack but buyers returned within hours, Talos' Kelly Ye said in a Bloomberg report.
Cook Political Report says Democrats will likely win the House and rates the Senate a tossup, per CoinDesk.
Crypto PACs spent over $170M on the election per CoinDesk; a Reuters investigation put it at about $176M.

briefs.title: BTCPay Server tells users to switch off servers
briefs.summary: Attackers logged in as admins on servers older than v2.4.2 and drained hot wallets; BTCPay's own servers run v2.4.7 and were not hit. No loss total has been given, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Coinbase premium stays negative
briefs.summary: Bitfire puts the Coinbase premium at -0.18% to -0.27%, a sign of weaker US demand, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Spot ether ETFs see outflows too
briefs.summary: Spot ETH ETFs lost about $156M, per KuCoin's daily market report.

briefs.title: Companies object to OKXICE tokenized stocks
briefs.summary: OKXICE's 28 Oct notice listed 38 objecting companies, up from 9 on 15 Oct, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Walmart-backed OnePay accepts USDC
briefs.summary: Some US users can deposit USDC from 12 blockchains into OnePay checking, converted to dollars by Stripe's Bridge, with no exchange fee at launch.

briefs.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy buy
briefs.summary: Strategy holds 848,517 BTC and MSCI decides on index exclusions on 11 Nov; no new purchase had been announced as of this update, per Yahoo/24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: China adds crypto to its anti-graft drive
briefs.summary: A party resolution adopted 29 Oct calls to "resolutely combat corruption committed via the internet, virtual currency, cross-border capital, and blockchain". It changes no law.

briefs.title: Brazil's crypto licensing deadline passes
briefs.summary: About 40 of an expected 150-200 firms applied by the 30 Oct deadline; banks must stop serving unlicensed providers from 6 Nov, per CoinGabbar.
